summary: PD-17 FIX: the confined FILESYSTEM native tool module (`src/plugin/live/confined-fs-tool.mjs`) is plain JS loaded through the route-C seam by the byte-copied realm row (`a5sf-realm-row.mjs`, placement 120). It registers the model-visible `read`/`write`/`edit`/`read_image` by delegating to the pinned host package's public `apply` (the same definitions the preset served) on a narrowed view of the Member's isolated scope, so the tools' `fs` resolves the CONFINED provider. tsc never emits `.mjs`, so it rides the dist mirror at its repo-relative layout; the realm row resolves it with `new URL('./confined-fs-tool.mjs', import.meta.url)`, so without this entry the installed face would fail at member setup with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND — not at build time.
